open_points.subject: listener lifecycle operations
open_points.text: `module:instance_lifecycle` opens the owner interface's listener and then, unless the start is owner-only, the service API's; the listeners already opened are closed
open_points.question: Which named capability opens the listeners and performs the close-on-failure cleanup, and does `capability:instance_lifecycle.start_instance` call it or call separate capabilities of the two surface modules?
options: Add an `instance_lifecycle` capability that opens both listeners and closes any already opened after failure
Give `service_api` and `owner_interface` separate open and close listener capabilities called by `start_instance`
Treat opening and closing sockets as unnamed internal work of `capability:instance_lifecycle.start_instance`
open_points.default_guess: Make listener opening and failure cleanup private work of `capability:instance_lifecycle.start_instance`, with that capability directly owning both listener handles.
